title: Reranking and context assembly
content: NeuroFlow uses the cross-encoder model cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 to rerank fused retrieval candidates. The reranker scores query and candidate-text pairs and sorts candidates by descending score. The default context token budget is 4000 tokens. Context assembly preserves chunk provenance, including source name and page number when available. The final context result includes the context string, chunks_used, total_tokens, and sources. Each RetrievalResult exposes the chunk_id used to identify the underlying database chunk.
